explanation: Variation of parameters gives g=e^(2x)[−cos(x)∫x sin(x) dx+sin(x)∫x cos(x) dx]=xe^(2x). Direct verification gives g′=(1+2x)e^(2x) and g″=(4+4x)e^(2x), so g″−4g′+5g=xe^(2x). This tests particular solutions of second-order linear ODEs using variation of parameters, which is absent from the supplied course topics.
